name: tw.com.ecpay.paymentgatewaykit.core.card.CreditCardActivity
description: During checkout, this ECPay (綠界科技) Payment Gateway SDK screen handles card payments, including UnionPay, and continues the flow if the bank requests 3-D Secure verification. It returns the payment result to the app.
disableEffect: Card payment, including any required bank verification, may fail to open or finish.
